identifier=7
with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as server,socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as client:
 server.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));server.settimeout(2);client.settimeout(2)
 def respond():
  query,address=server.recvfrom(512)
  server.sendto(struct.pack('!HHHHHH',8 if n==1 else 7,0x8000,0,0,0,0),address)

import socket,threading
body=b'ok' if n==1 else b'hello'
server=socket.socket();server.settimeout(2);server.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));server.listen()
def serve():
 with server.accept()[0] as conn:
  conn.settimeout(2);request=b''
  while b'\r\n\r\n' not in request:request+=conn.recv(4096)
  conn.sendall(b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nConnection: close\r\nContent-Length: '+str(len(body)).encode()+b'\r\n\r\n'+body)
thread=threading.Thread(target=serve);thread.start()
with socket.socket() as client:
 client.settimeout(2);client.connect(server.getsockname());client.sendall(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: lab.test\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n');raw=b''
 while True:
  chunk=client.recv(2)
  if not chunk:break
  raw+=chunk
 print(raw.split(b'\r\n')[0].decode())
thread.join();server.close()
